scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @evemange/api & npm run dev -w @evemange/web
scripts.dev:stack: npm run docker:up && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w @evemange/config && npm run build -w @evemange/ui && npm run build -w @evemange/api && npm run build -w @evemange/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @evemange/config && npm run typecheck -w @evemange/ui && npm run typecheck -w @evemange/api && npm run typecheck -w @evemange/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @evemange/config && npm run lint -w @evemange/ui && npm run lint -w @evemange/api && npm run lint -w @evemange/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @evemange/config && npm run test -w @evemange/ui
